dialog.title: Export a month
dialog.intro: Choose up to {{days}} days. The file is made in the background with the filters and columns on your screen; collect it from My exports.
dialog.queued: Your export is queued. You can leave this page; the file will be waiting in My exports.
dialog.failed: The export could not be queued.

problem.missingEnd: Choose both a start and an end date.
problem.reversed: The end date is before the start date.
problem.tooLong: The range is longer than {{days}} days. Choose a shorter range.
problem.noColumns: The grid shows no columns to export.

page.title: My exports
page.subtitle: The files you asked for from the inquiry screens. A file is kept for 7 days.
page.loadFailed: Your exports could not be loaded.
page.none: You have not asked for an export yet. Use Export month… on an inquiry screen.
page.cutHint: The file reached the row ceiling and is not complete. Ask for a shorter range.
page.failedHint: The export failed. Ask for it again, or report it if it keeps failing.
page.downloadFailed: The file could not be downloaded.
page.removedHint: The file was removed after 7 days. Ask for the export again.
